description: The frozen, additively growing error-code registry. `failure_class` is the D18 attribution enum; `http` is the status the REST surface uses; SSE error events carry the same code/class. Clients map `code` to localized strings — `message` on the wire is user-safe English.

invalid_api_key.description: Publishable key missing, malformed, revoked, or hash mismatch.

unauthorized.description: Missing or invalid credentials for this endpoint.

forbidden.description: The authenticated member lacks permission for this action.

token_expired.description: Session JWT expired; the SDK recreates the session transparently and retries.

unknown_agent.description: agent_id does not exist in this project.

unknown_manifest.description: manifest_hash not registered; POST the body to /v1/manifests and retry.

duplicate_message.description: client_msg_id already processed; details.turn_id carries the existing turn.

thread_not_found.description: Thread does not exist or is not visible to this end user.

validation_failed.description: Request body failed contract validation; details carries locators.

quota_exceeded.description: A project quota or plan cap tripped; a clear refusal, never a mystery 500.

missing_approval.description: A destructive tool_results entry arrived without an approval object.

jti_reused.description: Single-use authorization id was already consumed; the continuation is rejected.

pending_tools_unanswered.description: The continuation left one or more pending tool calls without a result.

provider_error.description: The model provider failed; upstream carries {provider, status, code}.

provider_rate_limited.description: The developer's provider key is rate-limited or out of quota upstream.

provider_auth_failed.description: The vaulted BYOK key was rejected by the provider; fix it in Console → Settings → provider keys.

segment_timeout.description: The provider stream stalled past the segment deadline.

cancelled.description: The client stopped the stream; the segment ends done{cancelled}.

internal.description: Unattributed gateway fault; alarmed and triaged — never the catch-all for the classes above.
